answer_format: End your reply with a final line that contains \boxed{<answer>}.

rules.normalisation: hotpot_evaluate_v1.py normalize_answer: lower case; characters of string.punctuation removed; \b(a|an|the)\b replaced by a space; white space collapsed
rules.f1: token F1 of the normalised strings; 0 when either normalises to yes, no or noanswer and they differ; 0 when no token is shared
rules.placeholder: src/content_scoring.is_placeholder (content/1.2.0): a box is a placeholder when its content (wrappers, bold and '$' removed, whitespace collapsed, quotes and a final period dropped, case folded) is empty; or a slot name bare (^(?:(?:the|your|my|final|correct|chosen)\s+)*(?:answer|number)(?:\s+(?:here|goes\s+here|will\s+be\s+here|letter|number|text))?$); or wholly in angle brackets a slot name (^(?:(?:the|your|my|final|correct|chosen)\s+)*(?:answer|number|letter|option|choice|value|result|solution)(?:\s+(?:here|goes\s+here|will\s+be\s+here|letter|number|text))?$) or an option template (^(?:option|choice|letter)\s*(?:\(\s*[a-z]\s*\)|[a-z])$). It is skipped as the answer box and removed from the text before the reading without a box, as is a brace-less copy.; or a content that, unwrapped and cleaned, normalises to '' or 'answer'
rules.clean: a leading copied '<answer>' (optional '-' or ':') removed, then angle brackets around the whole content
rules.content: the last complete box that is not a placeholder; else, on the text with every placeholder box (with or without its backslash) and every brace-less placeholder copy removed: a final unclosed box when there is no complete box at all; else the rest of the line after the last answer cue; else the last non-empty line, read inside its first complete backslash-less box when it holds one; each unwrapped and cleaned; None for an empty output
rules.unchanged: strict, lenient and compliance stay those of hotpot-boxed/1.0.0
